# Vendored QR renderer

`qr-code-styling-1.9.2.js` is the unmodified browser bundle from the npm package `qr-code-styling@1.9.2`, downloaded with `npm pack --ignore-scripts`.

- Source: https://github.com/kozakdenys/qr-code-styling
- Release: https://github.com/kozakdenys/qr-code-styling/releases/tag/v1.9.2
- License: MIT, reproduced in `qr-code-styling.LICENSE.txt`.
- Bundled encoder: Kazuhiko Arase's `qrcode-generator`; its MIT notice is reproduced in `qrcode-generator.LICENSE.txt`.
- npm package SHA-1: `071714860a7e59829e8822c9575e989042139d2d`.

The browser loads this bundle only when the QR builder opens. No CDN, server API, or tracking service is used. The source-map comment refers to an omitted development map; it is not required to run the library.
